title: Diameter of Binary Tree
inputFormat: root is the root node of a nonempty binary tree. Test inputs use level-order arrays with null for missing children; the function receives nodes with val, left, and right properties.
outputFormat: Return the maximum number of edges on a path between any two nodes.

visuals.title: Count edges, not nodes

visuals.caption: For [1,2,3,4,5], the path 4 → 2 → 1 → 3 has 3 edges. A longest path need not pass through the root.
